Dua for entering the toilet

Before entering the toilet, said outside it.

اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ

Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith

O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils (all evil and impure things).

Share on WhatsApp 0

Reference

Sahih al-Bukhari 142; Sahih Muslim 375
